Services

Bow to stern.

Routine washes. Full restoration. Protection that holds up in Florida sun and salt.

01

Full Detail

Deep wash, vinyl care, metal polish and hand wax, with compound for oxidation when needed.

02

Detail Wash

A deep wash that removes salt, grime, mold and rust stains from every surface and compartment.

03

Wet Sanding

A 3-step process that removes heavy oxidation and scratches and brings back the gelcoat shine.

04

Teak Cleaning and Restoration

Scrub, brighten and oil to bring back the original color of the wood.

05

Gelcoat Repair

Repair for damaged gelcoat on your boat.

06

Bottom Paint Service

Improves fuel efficiency and makes the hull easier to clean.
